an4.107:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave cattārome mūsikupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an4.107:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo gādhaṃ kattā hoti no vasitā
an4.107:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti
an4.107:2.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ
an4.107:2.4: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an4.107:2.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gādhaṃ kattā hoti no vasitā
an4.107:2.6: seyyathāpi sā bhikkhave mūsikā gādhaṃ kattā no vasitā
an4.107:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo vasitā hoti no gādhaṃ kattā
an4.107:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti
an4.107:3.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ
an4.107:3.4: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an4.107:3.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo vasitā hoti no gādhaṃ kattā
an4.107:3.6: seyyathāpi sā bhikkhave mūsikā vasitā no gādhaṃ kattā
an4.107:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo neva gādhaṃ kattā hoti no vasitā
an4.107:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyāpuṇāti
an4.107:4.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ
an4.107:4.4: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an4.107:4.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo neva gādhaṃ kattā hoti no vasitā
an4.107:4.6: seyyathāpi sā bhikkhave mūsikā neva gādhaṃ kattā no vasitā
an4.107:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo gādhaṃ kattā ca hoti vasitā ca
an4.107:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti
an4.107:5.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ
an4.107:5.4: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an4.107:5.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gādhaṃ kattā ca hoti vasitā ca
an4.107:5.6: seyyathāpi sā bhikkhave mūsikā gādhaṃ kattā ca vasitā ca
an4.107:5.8: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro mūsikupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
